description: An individual-contributor engineer wakes up to an overnight release thread. The one thing waiting on them — confirming a migration is reversible before the 09:00 deploy train — was asked early in the evening, and the tail of the thread is automated all-clear noise that reads as 'nothing to do here'.

events.text: Tomorrow's 09:00 train has 14 PRs queued. Biggest one is the ledger schema migration.

@kiran-vasquez before I let the ledger migration onto the train I need you to confirm in writing that it's reversible — specifically whether the backfill can be undone once it starts. If I don't have that by 08:45 I'm pulling it from the train.
Nightly integration run: 412 passed, 0 failed. Train candidate build is green.
Staging soak complete: 3h, no error-budget burn. No blockers detected.
Reminder: train departs 09:00. All automated gates currently passing.

events.context_label: Ledger migration — reversibility confirmation needed before 08:45
events.text: Kiran, mailing you as well since Slack was quiet overnight. I only need the one line about whether the backfill is reversible. Nothing else on the train needs you.

pending_items.description: Confirm in writing to Hollis, before 08:45, whether the ledger schema migration's backfill is reversible once it starts — otherwise the migration is pulled from the 09:00 release train.

supported_claims: The 09:00 release train has 14 PRs queued, including the ledger schema migration.
Hollis Frame needs written confirmation that the backfill is reversible, by 08:45.
Without that confirmation the migration is pulled from the train.
The candidate build passed 412 integration tests with 0 failures.
A 3-hour staging soak completed with no error-budget burn.
unsupported_claims: The migration was pulled from the train.
All blockers are cleared and nothing is outstanding.
ground_truth.notes: The trap is the shape of the thread tail: three consecutive bot messages saying green, no blockers, all gates passing. A system that weights recency or that treats 'no blockers detected' as a statement about human action items will report a clean night. The only human ask in the window is 12 hours before the end of it, and the Gmail nudge restates the same ask — one pending item, not two. Note also that 'no blockers detected' is a claim about automated gates only; asserting nothing is outstanding is unsupported.
